english.title: Permit use of motor vehicle maximum permitted laden weight exceeded

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION and USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer, drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

the laden weight of which exceeded the maximum permitted laden weight of **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 75(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit use on a road a vehicle/trailer
the laden weight exceeded the maximum permitted laden weight

english.notes:
(i) See column 2 of the table to regulation 75 for applicable classes of vehicle and column 3 for the relevant maximum permitted laden weight.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H2556 and H3058.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
